messages:
ashley: Opening a docs PR to add TritonLite-2B to the model catalog. Need bench links, a short migration blurb for embed sharding, and an SDK snippet.

ravi: Uploaded benches: https://internal-bench/reports/tritonlite-2b-2026-03-22. Quick numbers: seq=512 GPU p50=39ms p95=115ms; CPU fallback p50=215ms. Quantized variant reduces p95 ~18ms but note tokenization differences.

samir: Draft snippet: use client.model("tritonlite-2b").embed(..., shard_count=1). Show fallback retry without shard_count.

kevin: Prefer the new SDK pattern in docs. Also there's a trailing space in tritonlite-2b.md line 40, markdownlint will flag.

toni: Found a broken anchor: compatibility-notes vs compatibility_notes. I'll fix the heading in this PR and add a follow-up to add an anchor-check to docs CI.

ashley: I'll add a migration note: SDK v2 requires explicit shard_count. Include recommended defaults: shard_count=1 for normal workloads, 2 for high fanout. Add regression test reminder for long-unicode tokenization.

docs-bot: PR created by ashley: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4621. Reviewers added: @toni @kevin @ravi.

kevin: markdownlint failed; pushing a quick whitespace fix.

toni: anchor fix + lint patch pushed. kicking off smoke build.

ravi: approved bench numbers; request linking to raw artifact and the bench script in the card.

kevin: smoke passed in us-east. merging after editorial pass.

ashley: merged. Will notify support and paste snippet into the migration playbook. Thanks everyone! :tada:
